title: Longest increasing subsequence
prompt: Read lines from standard input; each line holds integers separated by single spaces (possibly none). For each line print `strict=A nondecreasing=B`: A is the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence and B the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence. A subsequence keeps the order of the numbers but may skip some of them. A line with no numbers gives `strict=0 nondecreasing=0`. All values fit easily in 32 bits.

cases.name: example
cases.expected_output:
strict=4 nondecreasing=4
strict=3 nondecreasing=4
strict=1 nondecreasing=1
strict=1 nondecreasing=1
strict=0 nondecreasing=0

cases.name: hidden1
cases.expected_output:
strict=1 nondecreasing=4
strict=4 nondecreasing=5
strict=6 nondecreasing=6

cases.name: hidden2
cases.expected_output:
strict=4 nondecreasing=6
strict=1 nondecreasing=1
strict=2 nondecreasing=4

cases.name: hidden3
cases.expected_output:
strict=0 nondecreasing=0
strict=0 nondecreasing=0
strict=1 nondecreasing=1
